patch_description: Two improvements: (1) vectorize the min-triangle-area computation (precomputed triple indices, one cross-product batch per evaluation) — the prior program showed this is ~50x faster, letting us afford many more optimization runs; (2) replace the single circle+center run with an elite-ladder basin-hopping scheme per the recommendation: multiple deterministic initializations (circle+center, two-ring, jittered grids with fixed seeds), each refined by coordinate descent, then the top-3 elites are re-optimized under 8–10 deterministic perturbation kicks at amplitudes 0.01–0.08, each followed by re-descent. This exploits the known effectiveness of multi-amplitude kicks around top elites while keeping full determinism and a reasonable runtime.
